summary.text: Mark Campbell is the Republican candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 39, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary without opposition.
Ballotpedia's race overview describes him as a performance manager for Gerber Collision & Glass.
